extracted.name: Grilled Zucchini and Squash
extracted.description: Grilled zucchini and squash perfectly seasoned with garlic are cooked in foil with butter until juicy and flavorful for a delicious summer side.
ingredient_lines: 2 zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut in 1/4 inch slices
instruction_lines: Gather the ingredients. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat.
Place zucchini and squash on a large sheet of aluminum foil; dot with butter. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Seal vegetables in the foil packet.
Place the foil packet on the preheated grill until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
